zgkt5sdr.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Frosted Tips - White - 150 cm
zgkt5sdr.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Artificial Christmas Tree Frosted Tips - White - 150 cm
zgkt5sdr.sourceDescription: This Artificial Christmas Tree with LED is designed to bring the spirit of the festive season into your home with its sleek and modern appearance. Its cone-shaped design and dynamic LED light show make it a stunning centerpiece for your seasonal decor, perfect for creating a winter wonderland in both indoor and sheltered outdoor spaces. Crafted from abrasion-resistant materials like PVC and steel, this tree provides a durable and lasting addition to your holiday celebrations. Materials: This tree is crafted from PVC and steel, ensuring an abrasion-resistant and long-lasting build. The materials are selected to maintain their appearance over time, bringing joy year after year without wear. Included Components: It includes an LED string light with dynamic lighting patterns and a USB plug, making it easy to illuminate the space with vibrant lights. A sturdy steel stand is provided to keep the tree stable. Features /Function /Design: With eight LED flash modes, the lighting offers multiple visual experiences, from steady to dynamic displays, allowing you to customize the ambiance according to your mood or event. Recommended Uses: Suitable for the living room, garden, and terrace, this tree's versatility in design shines in any setting, enhancing the festive atmosphere wherever placed. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions using a screwdriver. The non-traditional USB plug offers a universal power source connection, ensuring easy setup and teardown. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Durable Number of PVC tips: 680 Lights type: LED string lights Lights color: Gold Number of LEDs: 150 Distance between LEDs: 10 cm LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Batteries Included: No Voltage: 5 Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

p8zd7sm1.baseName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Gilded Evergreen
p8zd7sm1.variantName: Ark Mat 58cm Artificial Wreath - Gilded Evergreen
p8zd7sm1.sourceDescription: Bring a seasonal touch to your home with a beautiful artificial decorative wreath, available in a choice of summer, autumn, winter and Christmas designs. Simply select your preferred seasonal style to create the perfect look for your home. Ideal for decorating front doors, porches, walls, windows, hallways and other areas around the home, these versatile artificial wreaths are an easy way to refresh your décor throughout the year. Choose a bright and colourful summer design, warm autumnal style, elegant winter decoration or festive Christmas wreath to suit the season. Designed with decorative artificial flowers, foliage and seasonal details, these wreaths offer the look of natural seasonal decoration without the maintenance required by fresh flowers and foliage. They can be enjoyed year after year as part of your seasonal decorations. Perfect for everyday home décor as well as Christmas decorating, seasonal celebrations, parties and special occasions, these artificial wreaths make a simple and attractive addition to your home. Please note that each seasonal option is a separate design. Please select your preferred summer, autumn, winter or Christmas wreath from the available variations. For decorative use only. Keep the wreath away from open flames, naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other sources of heat, as the materials may melt or ignite. Do not place the wreath near fire or expose it to excessive heat. Ensure the wreath is securely attached to a suitable surface to prevent it from falling. Take care when handling and hanging the product to avoid injury from any sharp edges, wires or fixing components. Keep packaging materials and small parts away from children to prevent potential choking hazards. Inspect the wreath before use and do not use it if any parts are damaged or broken. If adding decorative lights, ensure they are suitable for the intended use and follow the manufacturer's safety instructions. Retain these safety instructions for future reference. Ark Mat, The Storage Centre, West Park, Wellington, TA21 9AD, United Kingdom
